name: Sealing and Maintaining Tile: What Actually Needs Doing
title-tag: Sealing & Maintaining Tile | Cottage Lake Tile Install
meta-description: What tile actually needs sealing (cement grout, stone), what never does (porcelain, epoxy grout), safe cleaners, and when dingy grout just needs a deep clean.
post-summary: April 6, 2027 · Most tile never needs sealing — porcelain and epoxy grout are sealed by the kiln and by chemistry. Only cement grout and natural stone drink a sealer. The honest maintenance list: pH-neutral cleaner, no vinegar on stone, sealer on the schedule the water test sets, and a deep clean — not another coat of sealer — for dingy grout.
